sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach have been in strong form with four wins in their last five outings. They will be heavy favourites against Alsager Town, who sit bottom with just 4 points and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture between two mid-table contenders separated by just two points. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, travel to Eccleshall in what looks like a competitive clash between sides in the upper half. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, entertain Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town, sixth and in-form with five consecutive wins, face Foley Meir away; a stumble here would halt their momentum. Barnton host Shawbury United, with Shawbury's alarming six-game losing streak making them heavy underdogs. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a meeting of mid-table sides, while Crewe face Allscott Heath at home as they bid to climb away from the lower reaches. Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday and then travel to Brereton Social on Wednesday to face Wednesfield Community in a midweek clash. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement battle between two of the division's poorest performers.
